payload.blocks: Landing the data move (451 items, 51 discussions, head-grant swap), and so the rest of phase 5 and the plan's end.
payload.headline: Phase 5 data move: pause backlog and discussion writers for ~15 minutes so the move lands on the trunk tip?

parts.cause: The secretary, the supervisor and two shapers (orchestration-skeleton, component-authority) write docs/backlog.md and docs/discussions continuously, and their running sessions hold the old grants, so after the move they would keep writing the old paths until restarted.

options.does: The supervisor asks the secretary and the two shapers to land their pending edits and hold backlog/discussion writes; the lead re-runs `fgos migrate portfolio` on the trunk tip (idempotent, ~10 min including gates) and lands it; then the supervisor restarts those heads so they get the new grants.
options.gain: No row or discussion edit is lost; every head writes the new paths afterwards.
options.harm: Those sessions pause for about 15 minutes and restart.
options.label: Short freeze, then restart heads (recommended)

options.cost: Unknown number of retries; stray writes to clean.
options.does: The lead re-runs the move on the tip and retries the land until a window happens to be quiet; heads restart whenever they next rotate.
options.harm: Repeated conflicts and dirty-overlap refusals; heads keep writing docs/backlog.md (now a pointer) and docs/discussions until they restart, which the next migrate run must sweep up.
options.label: Land without a freeze

parts.recommendation: Short freeze coordinated by the supervisor, then restart the secretary, supervisor-owned writers and shapers so their grants match the new layout.

scope.allows: The supervisor pausing and restarting those heads once for this move; the lead re-running the migration on the tip and landing it.
scope.forbids: Discarding any pending row or discussion edit.

parts.what: The move is built and committed on work-data-model/p05h (bcfcf608b): docs/backlog.md becomes a pointer, rows become plans/backlog/<id>.md, docs/discussions/* become plans/discussions/ds-<id>-<topic>/, grants swap (shaper -> plans/discussions; secretary, supervisor, planner drop docs/backlog.md and docs/discussions). But in the 10 minutes since its base, main gained 2 backlog rows and 1 orchestration-skeleton edit; landing it would conflict or drop them, and shapers keep docs/discussions dirty in the main checkout.
